contracts.description: The Rust project's focused checks run successfully.
Machine-readable report fields and values match the Python implementation.
A root rollout includes linked descendant usage without losing per-rollout classifications.
Token, model, reasoning, duration, and date-sensitive cost values are aggregated as exposed by Python.
Default output is a readable report containing the discoverable rollout, scope, model, token, and pricing facts.
A missing rollout exits unsuccessfully with a visible not-found explanation.
Every initial report contract still passes after the extension.
Omitting --prices preserves the initial JSON report exactly.
A valid --prices file can override a built-in model and add a new model using the declared per-million rates.
Unreadable, malformed, and invalid price files fail with a useful error.
